description: Use to screen general FBAR and Form 8938 thresholds from aggregate balance, filing status, residence, and account-count facts. Do not request account numbers, institution names, or statements.

account_count.description: Number of foreign accounts, if known.

lives_abroad.description: True if your tax home is outside the United States (higher Form 8938 thresholds apply).

max_aggregate_foreign_balance_usd.description: The highest combined value of ALL your foreign financial accounts at any point during the year, in USD.

unfiled_years.description: How many past years of FBARs you have NOT filed but should have. 0 or omitted if current.
